parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Channabasamma, W/O Gurunath Reddy, Public Relation Officer

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed M.C.No.14/2023 seeking dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act. She is facing inconvenience in attending the Court at Lingsugur due to her work and son's education.

legal_principles.principle: A transfer of a case from one court to another can be allowed if the petitioner has made out any ground for such transfer.
legal_principles.held: The following point would arise for my consideration: Whether the petitioner has made out any ground to allow the petition. My answer to the above point is 'Affirmative'.
cited_cases: Channabasamma vs Gurunath Reddy, (2023) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A petitioner seeking transfer of a case may rely on inconvenience caused to them in attending the court.
legal_principles.held: She is facing inconvenience in attending the Court at Lingsugur.

outcome.final_order: Petition is allowed, case transferred from Lingsugur to Family Court at Bengaluru.

use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition in family court
advising on withdrawal of divorce petition
preparing for a divorce case in Karnataka
